verdict.rationale: Navan has its own AI assistants (Ava, Navan Edge), so asking whether it can act as an MCP client is fair, and the axis applies. All MCP evidence describes the opposite role: Navan hosts an MCP server that external clients like Claude, Cursor and VS Code connect to. Nothing shows Navan or its assistants plugging in third-party MCP servers to use their tools, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
